scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=client && npm run lint --workspace=server
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace=client && npm run lint:fix --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=client -- --watchAll=false --passWithNoTests && npm run test --workspace=server -- --watchAll=false --passWithNoTests
scripts.test:watch: npm run test --workspace=client && npm run test --workspace=server
